Deep Exfoliation

Hydration and Nourishment
CBD oil deeply hydrates the skin, restores the natural barrier, and leaves the skin soft, supple, and refreshed.
Anti-Inflammatory Properties
CBD’s anti-inflammatory effects help soothe redness and irritation, making this treatment ideal for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
Relaxation and Stress Relief
CBD interacts with the body’s systems to promote relaxation, helping to relieve stress and enhance the overall spa experience.
Enhanced Skin Health
Combining traditional Korean techniques with CBD’s antioxidant properties, this scrub supports skin repair, protection, and long-lasting health.

children.html:
• Prepare for Your Session: Arrive early to schedule your Women's CBD Oil Body Scrub, as appointments are first-come, first-served. Begin by soaking in the hot tubs within the bathhouse area for 15-20 minutes to prepare your skin for exfoliation. This step softens your skin and opens pores, ensuring the exfoliation and CBD oil application deliver maximum benefits.
  • Enjoy Your CBD Oil Body Scrub Session: Performed in the nude for a full-body experience, a professional scrub attendant uses traditional Korean exfoliation mitts to gently remove dead skin cells and impurities. Following the exfoliation, your skin is treated with a luxurious CBD oil application to hydrate, calm, and rejuvenate, leaving it smooth and glowing.
  • Delight in Rejuvenated Skin: Rinse off to reveal refreshed, revitalized skin. Complete your visit by moisturizing to lock in hydration and relaxing further with King Spa’s pools, saunas, or additional spa services for the ultimate self-care experience.

children.html:
Vanessa Phillips

I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler

Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna

I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.
Megan Durst

I've gone with my small group multiple times and with my spouse and we all thoroughly enjoy it. I usually get the body scrub because who doesn't like their skin feeling like a baby's skin? And the ice bath has become one of my favorite parts, but I've always enjoyed the variety of saunas and bade pool, and the outdoor pool(and hot tub, and bridge) is beautiful & can be relaxing too(Just maybe not on a Saturday when it's busy😅). Definitely going back.
Mykyla J

This place was AMAZING, i stepped out of many comfort zones by going here. Things are a little confusing if you are getting the body scrub service, but there were other people there who helped even if the staff couldn't. Everybody was so friendly. I will continue to keep coming back. It's a 4 hour drive from where i stay, but it is worth the drive. I will also bring other people back along with me spreading the word of this amazing place !!!
Asel Dav

King Spa in Chantilly, VA, is a Korean-inspired spa offering a range of wellness and relaxation services. It features various saunas, including traditional Korean heated rooms, salt rooms, and cold rooms, designed to promote detoxification and relaxation. Additionally, King Spa offers body scrubs, massages, and other therapeutic treatments. The spa also includes amenities such as pools, relaxation lounges, and dining options, making it a comprehensive destination for a rejuvenating experience. This is my favorite place to relax… Highly recommend it, you will love this place ❤️

children.html:
What is the Women's CBD Oil Body Scrub?

The Women’s CBD Oil Body Scrub is a traditional Korean body scrub enhanced with CBD oil. This treatment includes a full-body exfoliation to remove dead cells and impurities while hydrating and soothing with the benefits of CBD oil application.

Is the Korean body scrub suitable for sensitive skin?

No, A Korean body scrub isn’t ideal for all skin types. If your skin is sensitive, you should avoid the treatment unless approved by your therapist.

Do I need to book an appointment in advance?

No, appointments for the Women’s CBD Oil Body Scrub are available on a first-come, first-served basis. We recommend arriving early to secure your session.

Is this treatment suitable for sensitive skin?

Yes, the combination of gentle exfoliation and CBD oil’s anti-inflammatory properties makes this treatment suitable for most skin types, including sensitive skin.

Will CBD make me feel “high”?

No, CBD does not have psychoactive effects. It is used in this treatment purely for its skincare and wellness benefits.

Do you wash hair during a Korean Body Scrub?

Yes, hair washing is included as part of the Korean body scrub treatment.

Can I enjoy other spa amenities before or after the scrub?

Absolutely! King Spa offers a variety of amenities, including pools, saunas, and relaxation areas, to enhance your experience before or after your treatment.

How often should I get this treatment?

For optimal results, we recommend scheduling a body scrub every 4-6 weeks to maintain smooth, glowing skin.

Do you offer other body scrub treatments?

Absolutely! We offer a range of body scrub treatments for men, women, and couples. Explore all our body scrub treatment offerings!
